Name: Horse-Skins-Replacements-Mod
Author: CarlMontAmida
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Just drop one of them into your Mods folder at a time — whichever color you want. Don't put all 4 in at once or they'll conflict.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Extract to Android/Data/com.zaneyork.stardewvalley

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Replaces the Old Horse Skin With 4 Replacement Skins

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You will need content patcher 1.20.0 or later[/color][/size]
